info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v4-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Payoff Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information on mortgage loan payoffs. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of payoff amounts for specific loans, making it essential for lenders, servicers, and financial institutions managing loan portfolios. Typical use cases include providing accurate payoff calculations for borrowers or automating the payoff process within financial applications. With this API, users can efficiently obtain the necessary data to enhance their operational workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payoff details for a specific loan, including the total amount required to pay off the loan and any applicable fees or interest.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a loan payoff operation. This should include all necessary parameters defined in the schema to successfully process the payoff request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the loan payoff information.

ListMortgageLoansPayoffsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the loan payoff operations GET request. It is expected to be a JSON string containing details related to loan payoff operations.
